package repository

import "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"

// StudentTaskAnswerRepository handles student attempts.
type StudentTaskAnswerRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer, maxAttempts *int) (domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error)
	Update(ctx Context, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer) error
	GetByID(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error)
	GetActiveForTaskAndStudent(ctx Context, taskID string, userID string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error)
	ListForTaskAndStudent(ctx Context, taskID string, userID string) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error)
	CountForTaskAndStudent(ctx Context, taskID string, userID string) (int, error)
	ListForStudent(ctx Context, userID string, limit, offset int) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error)
	CountForStudent(ctx Context, userID string) (int, error)
	GetProgressByTaskIDs(ctx Context, userID string, taskIDs []string) (map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress, error)
}

// AutoReviewRepository stores auto review results.
type AutoReviewRepository interface {
	Save(ctx Context, review domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview) error
	GetByAnswerID(ctx Context, answerID string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview, error)
}

// ManualReviewRepository stores manual review results.
type ManualReviewRepository interface {
	Save(ctx Context, review domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview) error
	GetByAnswerID(ctx Context, answerID string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview, error)
}

// TaskTestAnswerVariantRepository stores selected variants for test attempts.
type TaskTestAnswerVariantRepository interface {
	ReplaceForAnswer(ctx Context, answerID string, variants []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant) error
}

// TaskTestAnswerVariantReader reads persisted structured assessment choices.
type TaskTestAnswerVariantReader interface {
	ListForAnswer(ctx Context, answerID string) ([]domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant, error)
}
